system.longDesc:
Cost: 2+ SP

The character conducting electronic warfare on the ship has access to the Misdirect Command stunt and the Perceived S Weakness Gunnery stunt.

Most torpedoes have their own internal guidance systems making them impossible to hack. However, if a torpedo is being manually controlled, the sensors operator can attempt to wrest control of the torpedo from the other ship. If there is more than one torpedo, 2 SP can be spent to attempt to control each. See Electronic Warfare later in this chapter for details.
